description: This PHP source file defines the 'ViewConfigureAjaxUI' class, which extends SugarView to handle displaying and managing the AJAX configuration UI in the SuiteCRM administration panel. It includes methods for access control, rendering the configuration interface, and preparing data for templates.

classes.name: ViewConfigureAjaxUI
classes.description: A view class extending SugarView, responsible for rendering and managing the AJAX UI configuration page in the SuiteCRM admin module.

methods.name: _getModuleTitleParams
methods.description: Returns the title parameters for the module, including a link to the administration index and the label for AJAX configuration.

methods.name: preDisplay
methods.description: Performs an access check to ensure the current user is an admin; terminates execution if not authorized.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Prepares and assigns enabled and disabled modules for the AJAX UI configuration template, rendering the interface.
